scope: Check the generated AC1032 MLINESTYLE per-element handle-span implementation against one already-present public DWG and an independent LibreDWG 0.14 decode.

source.fixturePolicy: The DWG already exists in the adjacent LibreDWG repository. It was read in place and was not copied into or committed in libdxfrw.
source.producerProvenance: Not established. Repository location, AC1032 header and filename do not prove AutoCAD/ODA authorship.

currentReaderOutcome.strictWholeSourceOutput: Refused because DWG read disposition is incomplete; no output was published.

typedDependencyGraph.closure: The typed callback graph closes for this selected MLINESTYLE and its two LTYPE dependencies. This does not close the drawing-wide object graph or prove native semantics.

independentPeer.comparison: The peer independently agrees on the object and target identities, field order, and hard-pointer role code 5 for both element linetype references. It reports the common owner as code 8 and reactor as code 4; this receipt records those peer observations without widening the ODA-defined parser contract. LibreDWG JSON does not independently report the parser's absolute span offsets.

implementation.change: Add a manual corpus-profile selector that asserts the typed style identity, NOD-to-owner-to-style links, unique ByLayer LTYPE dependency, two target handles, exact parser-reported offsets and span widths/roles observed for this source. The selector also prepares the AC1032 MLINESTYLE output-source snapshot and verifies that changing either the element target handle or the target LTYPE name invalidates the snapshot, then permits retry after restoration. The receipt binds the invocation to the DWG SHA-256; the selector does not implement its own hash check and is not registered in CTest.

validation.physicalSelectorResult: PASS: exact NOD ACAD_MLINESTYLE entry -> dictionary 0x17 -> style 0x18 graph; both linetype refs resolve to unique LTYPE 0x15 ByLayer; parser spans are 627+16 and 643+16 bits, both hard-pointer code 5. The adapter admits the source snapshot; target-handle and LTYPE-name mutations are rejected and restoration passes.

selectedPhysicalOutputAttempt.firstRelevantGraphFailure: DICTIONARY 0x3A8 contains ACAD_DIMASSOC -> DIMASSOC 0x3B4 (type 526), which is absent from the qualified emitted-object graph.
selectedPhysicalOutputAttempt.independentPeerConfirmation: LibreDWG 0.14 JSON for this same DWG reports DICTIONARY handle 0x3A8 with ACAD_DIMASSOC target 0x3B4 and DIMASSOC handle 0x3B4 owned by 0x3A8.
selectedPhysicalOutputAttempt.consequence: Do not treat MLINESTYLE output-source admission as writer/readback evidence. Implement DIMASSOC graph closure and output/readback before retrying the selected physical export.

validation.fullTestSuites: NOT RUN; target-local build, physical source-profile selector, and nine focused CTests used.

remainingGates: Producer-qualified AutoCAD/ODA AC1032 span evidence remains absent.

Only selected-source MLINESTYLE admission and dependency snapshot are established. Drawing-wide graph closure, DIMASSOC target output, MLINESTYLE staged serialization/readback, strict output admission, native CAD, LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, or support claim does not follow from this profile.
